layout: the upstream layout (core/, styles/<slug>/style.json and styles/<slug>/demo/) under assets/lemo-engine, so each demo keeps its relative paths; the builder serves /core/ from the build folder
fonts_note: fonts that upstream keeps out of git are fetched by each demo's tools/fonts.sh from a pinned google/fonts commit or a versioned Google Fonts or JetBrains file; FrameMotion bundles the same files, with fetched_from and their SHA-256 here
not_bundled: every Markdown file (guides, STYLE.md, DEMO.md, FACTS.md, READMEs, the skill) and the image-generation prompts: CC BY-NC 4.0
the demo films, posters, stills and subtitles (CC BY 4.0) and all voice, music and mix files; Clawd and the Mascot Screencast style

the other 77 styles: those built on third-party footage, photos, maps, data, models or fetched asset packs (voice, HDRI, instruments), those whose fonts are subset by a script, the two Python-rendered styles, Chinese Ink Wash (its strokes are Chinese characters), Sci-Fi Sitcom Toon (it imitates a known television franchise), and those FrameMotion already covers (Stickman, Cutaway, Teardown, Pixel, Launch and Art engines)

core/render (upstream's renderer; FrameMotion renders with its own kit), core/audio, core/tts, core/image, core/assets, tools/, styleboard/, plugin/ and each demo's tools/, build.sh and Python scripts

retained_files.change: env(), marked by a FrameMotion comment: the environment map is rendered from the current frame's sky every time instead of cached per half degree of sun height from whichever frame reached it first (a frame depended on the frames drawn before it)
